output.reason: The linked PR [ev-fce5b51d8226] says what the one-line note [ev-a599a29bbeba] leaves out. It adds default authentication to the `crossplane xpkg extract` CLI command when it fetches from a remote registry, so that it works with private repositories. The only changed file is cmd/crank/xpkg/extract.go [ev-550788c9f271], which confirms the change is limited to the CLI. Exposure is limited to CLI users who extract packages from private registries, and nothing breaks if an operator does nothing (informational). The proposals cited only the release-note line and did not use the PR.
